top_signals.title: Diversification Will Win Out With Trump Accounts: Bartolini
top_signals.summary:
Matthew Bartolini, global head of research strategists, at State Street Investment Management, joins Isabelle Lee and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss the Trump Accounts after Elon Musk announced this morning that he would distribute a share of SpaceX to each child in the US.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
